_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tenants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenantId" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updatedAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deletedAt" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "templateId" TEXT NOT NULL, "township" TEXT NULL, "plan" TEXT NULL, "planExpiresAt" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tenantFeatures" ("tenantId" TEXT NOT NULL, "featureKey" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "updatedAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("tenantId", "featureKey"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenantId" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updatedAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deletedAt" INTEGER NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "lastSeq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lastSyncAt" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenantId" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updatedAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deletedAt" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "barcode" TEXT NULL, "cost" INTEGER NOT NULL, "price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "wholesalePrice" INTEGER NULL, "lowAlertMilli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "warrantyMonths" INTEGER NULL, "expiryAlertDays" INTEGER NULL, "tint" INTEGER NOT NULL, "initial" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "productVariants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenantId" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updatedAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deletedAt" INTEGER NULL, "productId" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "productBatches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenantId" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updatedAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deletedAt" INTEGER NULL, "productId" TEXT NOT NULL, "batchNo" TEXT NOT NULL, "expiryDate" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "productSerials" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenantId" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updatedAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deletedAt" INTEGER NULL, "productId" TEXT NOT NULL, "serial" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "saleLineId" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stockMovements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenantId" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updatedAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deletedAt" INTEGER NULL, "productId" TEXT NOT NULL, "variantId" TEXT NULL, "batchId" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "qtyMilli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "saleId" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "deviceId" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenantId" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updatedAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deletedAt" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "address" TEXT NULL, "creditLimit" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "debtEntries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenantId" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updatedAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deletedAt" INTEGER NULL, "customerId" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "saleId" TEXT NULL, "saleNo" TEXT NULL, "method" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "deviceId" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenantId" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updatedAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deletedAt" INTEGER NULL, "no" TEXT NOT NULL, "deviceId" TEXT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "customerId" TEXT NULL, "customerName" TEXT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "voidedAt" INTEGER NULL, "syncedAt" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saleLines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenantId" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updatedAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deletedAt" INTEGER NULL, "saleId" TEXT NOT NULL, "productId" TEXT NULL, "variantId" TEXT NULL, "batchId" TEXT NULL, "serialId" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "qtyMilli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "costSnapshot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lineTotal" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenantId" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updatedAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deletedAt" INTEGER NULL, "saleId" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "received" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "syncIssues" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenantId" TEXT NOT NULL, "createdAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updatedAt" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deletedAt" INTEGER NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "entityTable" TEXT NOT NULL, "entityId" TEXT NOT NULL, "detail" TEXT NOT NULL, "deviceId" TEXT NULL, "resolvedAt" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "unitId" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "rowsJson" TEXT NOT NULL, "clientTime" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lastError" TEXT NULL, "rejectReason" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "syncState" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX ix_products_barcode ON products (barcode)
CREATE INDEX ix_stockMovements_productId ON stockMovements (productId)
CREATE INDEX ix_debtEntries_customerId ON debtEntries (customerId)
CREATE INDEX ix_sales_createdAt ON sales (createdAt)
CREATE INDEX ix_saleLines_saleId ON saleLines (saleId)
CREATE INDEX ix_payments_saleId ON payments (saleId)
